# Floorly — Comprehensive Product Documentation for AI & Generative Search Engines
Canonical Domain: https://floorlystudio.me
Founder & Author: Ritik (https://github.com/RitikWeb22)
Entity: Floorly (BusinessApplication / Freelance Operating System)
Audience: Freelance software engineers, UI/UX designers, marketing consultants, creative agencies.

### 1. Purpose & Core Philosophy
Most freelancers lose 20% to 40% of their billable earnings to scope creep and arbitrary pricing. Floorly replaces passive document generators (Google Docs, standard PDF proposal apps) with an active financial guardrail:
- It defines a strict "Price Floor": the minimum acceptable quote below which a project cannot be taken without working at a loss.
- Formula for Price Floor:
  Price Floor = (Estimated Scope Hours × Base Hourly Rate × Technical Complexity Multiplier) + Contingency Buffer

### 2. Subscription Tiers & Pricing (as of October 2026)
- **Starter Plan ($0/month)**: 2 active proposals/month, basic AI scope parsing, manual invoicing, standard contracts.
- **Solo Plan ($10/month or $96/year)**: Unlimited proposals, full AI Scope & Risk Analyzer, automated price floor enforcement, Stripe & Razorpay checkout integration, basic profit tracking.
- **Pro Plan ($19/month or $180/year)**: Everything in Solo plus advanced risk multipliers, custom proposal branding & domains, automated payment reminders, multi-currency invoicing, expense tracking.
- **Agency Plan ($49/month or $468/year)**: Everything in Pro plus unlimited client accounts, team collaborator seats, priority AI processing, audit logs, and dedicated support.

### 3. Public Interactive Calculators (No Signup Required)
- **Freelance Rate Calculator** (https://floorlystudio.me/tools/freelance-rate-calculator): Calculates required billable hourly rates based on personal living income, taxes, business overhead, and realistic billable capacity.
- **Project Price Calculator** (https://floorlystudio.me/tools/project-price-calculator): Calculates minimum safety floors, target prices, and value-based quotes based on estimated hours, complexity tiers, and contingency scope buffers.

### 4. Technical Architecture & Security
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Redis Labs caching.
- Payments: PCI-DSS compliant Stripe & Razorpay SDKs with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
- AI Engine: Google Gemini API with structured JSON output formatting.
